name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in precision engineering. He honed his skills working with complex machinery and developed a keen eye for detail. A chance encounter with a race team needing someone to inspect parts led to a passion for the sport. He joined Iron Lynx after recognizing their commitment to excellence.

Wei's approach to quality control is proactive, believing in identifying potential issues before they become problems. He's known for his methodical approach and dedication to maintaining the highest standards. His ability to adapt to changing conditions and willingness to collaborate make him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Wei apart is his ability to find creative solutions to complex problems. He consistently seeks ways to improve processes and ensure that every aspect of the team's performance is of the highest quality. His loyalty and commitment to Iron Lynx make him a respected figure within the organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Wei has a focused gaze and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to lunch.
Insists on calibrating his own measuring tools every morning.
Frequently uses idioms and proverbs in technical discussions.
